sub_text: We offer Brazilian jiu-jitsu classes in a fun, safe, and inclusive environment.
meta_desc: Jiu-Jitsu Saint-Lambert is a Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu club located in Saint-Lambert, Québec.
bio: <1>Tetsuro started training Brazilian jiu-jitsu in 2016 and has been hooked ever since. His goal is to share his love of the sport to kids and adults in the neighbourhood.</1> <1>Tetsuro received his purple belt from Val Astraverkhau at <2>Mizu Studio</2> in 2022 and continues to learn and train regularly. He also runs the 8-12 year old kids' classes at Mizu Studio.</1>
location_desc: Classes take place at <1>Ballet Hop! Saint-Lambert</1>, located at <2>300A rue d’Arran</2>.
info_gi: Please bring a gi and belt (not necessary for trial class).
info_free_kids: Please use the code KIDSTRIAL for a free trial.
info_free_adults: Please use the code ADULTSTRIAL for a free trial.
info_more: More classes to be added in the future based on demand and rental space availability.
hiatus: We are currently in search of a new, permanent location to run our classes. A big thank you to everyone that came to train with us during the winter/spring season.
